program.intent: Parse and reconstruct syslog-style timestamp without year.
program.code:
def forward(groups):
    month, sp1, day, sp2, time = groups
    text = month + ' ' + day + ' ' + time
    dt = datetime.strptime(text, '%b %d %H:%M:%S')
    month_day_second = (dt.month - 1) * 31 * 86400 + (dt.day - 1) * 86400 + dt.hour * 3600 + dt.minute * 60 + dt.second
    return {'stored': [month_day_second], 'layout': [len(sp1), len(sp2), len(day)]}

def inverse(record):
    layout = record.get('layout', [])
    sp1, sp2, day_width = layout
    month_day_second = int(record['stored'][0])
    month = month_day_second // (31 * 86400) + 1
    day = (month_day_second % (31 * 86400)) // 86400 + 1
    seconds = month_day_second % 86400
    hour = seconds // 3600
    minute = (seconds % 3600) // 60
    second = seconds % 60
    month_name = datetime(2000, month, 1).strftime('%b')
    day_str = str(day).zfill(day_width)
    time = f'{hour:02}:{minute:02}:{second:02}'
    return month_name + (' ' * sp1) + day_str + (' ' * sp2) + time
